Tasteful Components, Made to Stand Out.

Rare UI is a free, open-source collection of rare animated React components. Browse them in action below and install any component with the shadcn CLI or MCP.

npx shadcn@latest add swamimalode07/rare-ui/fluid-orb
Quick Start
27+ rare and unique components

Just one file for each component. Add it with the shadcn CLI, using any package manager you like.
